source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
For the spout design, I want to make sure:
• There’s a clean open/close mechanism (no dripping)
• It’s properly sealed to prevent leaks into the base
• It’s easy to clean between uses
• The pour flow is smooth and controlled

Curious what your approach would be for implementing that in a simple, reliable way for V1.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Please do this. Make it look as close as possible. I really like the look and functionality of the render. Also, one difference from the rendering. The plate on the back of the machine that reads "Karla's Matcha Mixer", place that on the front. The spout and the mixers would be in front of the baristas but the customer would see it from a different angle. I want "Karla's Matcha Mixer to face the customer.

value_updates.valve_mechanism: solenoid valve positioned directly under the bowl
value_updates.actuation_behavior: dispense while the button is pressed and stop when the button is released
value_updates.pre_dispense_isolation: keep matcha out of the spout and tubing until dispensing is activated

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: Hey Karla. The machine is sturdy and everything functions as expected. I had a leak in a piece of the plumbing during testing that I need to get fixed.

execution.observed_behavior: After the client requested an operating demonstration that included pouring or dispensing, the freelancer claims that the machine's requested functions operate as expected while separately reporting a plumbing leak.

routing_warnings.description: The concern that the proposed spout would reduce matcha consistency and frothiness concerns dispensing-flow quality rather than valve actuation.
The clean, controlled, non-sputtering pour criteria concern dispensing-flow quality; the solenoid approach itself is reaffirmed rather than changed.
The observed plumbing leak is a runtime failure of liquid containment, not a failure of button-activated valve control.
The cracked plumbing fitting explains the liquid-containment failure and belongs to the leak-free plumbing Requirement.
